decisions.reason: A rye country bread sits squarely within the bakery's core rye-baking know-how, so management can read early sales and refine the recipe easily.
The premium raisin stollen draws on established confectionery expertise and won the Deutsches Brotinstitut gold medal again, a strong signal of quality and value.
A seeded rye mixed bread is a close extension of existing bread recipes, and the firm can interpret customer feedback and adjust it using related knowledge.
The dark barley malt rye bread builds on familiar rye techniques, though it is a slightly more niche variant within a broad bread range.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line and uses existing seasonal confectionery competence and gift-assortment channels.

The ancient grain bread, which the firm calls its newest masterpiece, applies its milling and baking know-how to a growing heritage-grain trend that its traditional, regional positioning can absorb and develop further.
